examples: The manager will allocate extra staff to the weekend shift.
مدیر کارکنان بیشتری را به شیفت آخر هفته اختصاص خواهد داد.
We need to allocate enough time for testing before the launch.
باید زمان کافی را برای آزمایش قبل از راه‌اندازی اختصاص دهیم.
The city allocated a new budget for public parks this year.
شهر امسال بودجه‌ی جدیدی را برای پارک‌های عمومی اختصاص داد.
miniContext: Every semester, the student council has to **allocate** a limited budget among dozens of clubs asking for funding. Some clubs want money for events, others for equipment, and there is rarely enough to satisfy everyone. The council usually starts by looking at how each club used its funds the previous year. Clubs that spent wisely tend to receive a larger share the next time around, which encourages more careful planning across campus.

examples: Can you give me an approximate price for the repair?
می‌توانی یک قیمت تقریبی برای تعمیر به من بدهی؟
The approximate distance between the two cities is three hundred kilometers.
فاصله‌ی تقریبی بین دو شهر سیصد کیلومتر است.
Her approximate age was hard to guess from the old photograph.
سن تقریبی او از روی عکس قدیمی به سختی قابل تشخیص بود.
miniContext: When Lina was packing for her trip, she didn't know the exact weight of her suitcase, so she gave an **approximate** number to the airline website. The tool only needed a rough estimate to calculate the baggage fee, not an exact figure. Later, at the airport, the scale showed a weight close to what she had guessed. Her approximate guess turned out to be good enough to avoid any extra charges.

examples: My vacation will coincide with my sister's wedding next month.
تعطیلات من با عروسی خواهرم ماه آینده همزمان خواهد شد.
The two meetings coincide, so I can only attend one of them.
این دو جلسه با هم همزمان هستند، پس فقط می‌توانم در یکی از آن‌ها شرکت کنم.
Their opinions on the project coincided almost perfectly.
نظرات آن‌ها درباره‌ی پروژه تقریباً کاملاً با هم مطابقت داشت.
miniContext: Maya realized that her college graduation would **coincide** with her brother's wedding in another city. For weeks, she tried to find a way to attend both events, but the dates simply overlapped. In the end, she had to choose the wedding, since it couldn't be rescheduled. Her parents promised to record the graduation ceremony so she wouldn't miss watching it entirely.

examples: The doctor recommended a comprehensive checkup before the surgery.
دکتر قبل از عمل جراحی یک معاینه‌ی جامع را توصیه کرد.
This textbook offers a comprehensive overview of world history.
این کتاب درسی یک نگاه جامع به تاریخ جهان ارائه می‌دهد.
Our insurance plan includes comprehensive coverage for accidents.
بیمه‌ی ما پوشش جامعی برای تصادفات شامل می‌شود.
miniContext: Before launching the new product, the marketing team put together a **comprehensive** plan that covered pricing, advertising, distribution, and customer support. Nothing was left out, since a partial plan had caused problems during the last launch. Every department reviewed the document and added details from their own area. By the time the plan was approved, everyone understood exactly how the launch would unfold.

examples: I can't conceive of living without my phone for a week.
نمی‌توانم تصور کنم که یک هفته بدون گوشی‌ام زندگی کنم.
The architects conceived a building shaped like a wave.
معماران ساختمانی را طراحی کردند که شکل یک موج داشت.
She conceived the idea for her novel during a long train ride.
او ایده‌ی رمانش را در طول یک سفر طولانی با قطار در ذهن پروراند.
miniContext: The sculptor said she could **conceive** an entire statue in her mind long before touching any clay. She would walk around the empty studio, picturing the shape from different angles until the idea felt complete. Only then would she begin sketching rough outlines on paper. Friends often asked how she could imagine something so detailed, and she simply said that the hardest part was turning the idea into stone.

examples: New employees are expected to conform to the company's dress code.
از کارمندان جدید انتظار می‌رود که از قانون پوشش شرکت پیروی کنند.
The building's wiring must conform to safety regulations.
سیم‌کشی ساختمان باید با مقررات ایمنی مطابقت داشته باشد.
He refused to conform to the group's expectations.
او از پیروی از انتظارات گروه خودداری کرد.
miniContext: New interns at the law firm quickly learn that they must **conform** to strict rules about formal dress and polite language. A few interns found the expectations old-fashioned, but most adjusted within the first week. Partners at the firm believe that following these shared standards builds trust with clients. Over time, even the most informal interns start to conform without really noticing it.

examples: She won the tennis tournament for three consecutive years.
او قهرمان مسابقات تنیس برای سه سال متوالی شد.
The team lost five consecutive games before finally winning.
تیم پنج بازی متوالی را باخت پیش از آن‌که سرانجام برنده شود.
Please number the pages in consecutive order.
لطفاً صفحات را به ترتیب متوالی شماره‌گذاری کن.
miniContext: The small bakery had sold out of croissants for seven **consecutive** mornings, surprising even the owner. Customers began lining up earlier each day, hoping to catch a fresh batch before it disappeared. On the eighth morning, the owner finally doubled the recipe. That one change ended the streak of empty shelves and kept regular customers happy again.

examples: Contrary to what he said, the store was actually open.
برخلاف چیزی که او گفت، مغازه در واقع باز بود.
Her calm reaction was contrary to everyone's expectations.
واکنش آرام او برخلاف انتظار همه بود.
On the contrary, I think the plan will work perfectly.
برعکس، من فکر می‌کنم این نقشه کاملاً موفق خواهد بود.
miniContext: Everyone expected the quiet new employee to struggle during her first presentation, but the result was **contrary** to those expectations. She spoke confidently and answered every question without hesitation. Her manager admitted later that first impressions can be misleading. From that day on, nobody assumed they could predict how she would perform.

examples: A smile can convey warmth even without words.
یک لبخند می‌تواند حتی بدون کلمه گرمی را منتقل کند.
I want to convey my sincere thanks for your help.
می‌خواهم تشکر صمیمانه‌ام را برای کمک شما ابراز کنم.
The letter conveyed the news gently.
آن نامه خبر را به آرامی رساند.
miniContext: A good children's book illustrator can **convey** an entire mood through color alone, without using any words. In one story, soft blue and yellow tones convey a feeling of calm morning light. In another, dark red backgrounds convey tension before a storm arrives. Readers often remember these feelings long after they forget the actual plot.

examples: The colors on the map correspond to different climate zones.
رنگ‌های روی نقشه با مناطق آب و هوایی مختلف مطابقت دارند.
We used to correspond by letter before email existed.
قبل از وجود ایمیل، ما با نامه مکاتبه می‌کردیم.
Her account of the accident corresponded with the witness's story.
روایت او از تصادف با داستان شاهد مطابقت داشت.
miniContext: While researching her family tree, Sara found old letters showing that her great-grandparents used to **correspond** regularly with relatives who had moved abroad. The handwriting styles and dates on the envelopes corresponded closely with the stories her grandmother used to tell. Reading through decades of letters, Sara realized how much effort people once put into staying connected across long distances. It made the occasional text message feel almost too easy by comparison.

examples: Drivers should not deviate from the marked route during the race.
رانندگان نباید در طول مسابقه از مسیر مشخص‌شده منحرف شوند.
The plane had to deviate from its flight path to avoid the storm.
هواپیما مجبور شد برای اجتناب از طوفان از مسیر پروازی خود منحرف شود.
His speech deviated from the original topic within minutes.
سخنرانی او ظرف چند دقیقه از موضوع اصلی منحرف شد.
miniContext: During the hiking trip, the guide warned everyone not to **deviate** from the marked trail because of loose rocks nearby. One hiker wandered off briefly to take a photo of a waterfall and quickly realized how uneven the ground became. After that, the whole group stayed close together and followed the path exactly as planned. The trip ended safely, with the guide reminding everyone that small decisions to deviate can lead to bigger problems.

examples: The course is divided into five discrete modules.
این دوره به پنج بخش جدا و مستقل تقسیم شده است.
Each department operates as a discrete unit with its own budget.
هر بخش به عنوان یک واحد جدا و مستقل با بودجه‌ی خاص خود عمل می‌کند.
The data was stored in discrete files rather than one large database.
داده‌ها به جای یک پایگاه داده‌ی بزرگ، در فایل‌های جدا و مستقل ذخیره شدند.
miniContext: The chemistry teacher explained that the course would be broken into several **discrete** units, each ending with its own short test. Students appreciated that the units were separate, since finishing one topic didn't depend on remembering everything from the last. If someone struggled with a single discrete section, they could catch up without falling behind in the rest of the course. This structure made the subject feel much less overwhelming overall.

examples: She has a dynamic personality that energizes the whole room.
او شخصیتی پویا دارد که کل اتاق را پرانرژی می‌کند.
The market for electric cars is extremely dynamic right now.
بازار خودروهای برقی در حال حاضر بسیار پویا و متغیر است.
Prices on the website change based on a dynamic pricing system.
قیمت‌ها در وب‌سایت بر اساس یک سیستم قیمت‌گذاری پویا تغییر می‌کنند.
miniContext: The new manager brought a **dynamic** energy to meetings that had become routine and quiet. She encouraged people to interrupt politely with new ideas instead of waiting until the end. Within a month, the team's discussions felt far more dynamic, with more disagreement but also more creativity. Several employees said they looked forward to meetings for the first time in years.

examples: The teacher explicitly told the students not to use calculators.
معلم به‌طور صریح به دانش‌آموزان گفت که از ماشین‌حساب استفاده نکنند.
The contract explicitly states that late payments will incur a fee.
قرارداد به‌طور صریح بیان می‌کند که پرداخت‌های تأخیری جریمه خواهند داشت.
She explicitly asked him not to tell anyone about the surprise party.
او به‌طور صریح از او خواست که درباره‌ی مهمانی غافلگیری به کسی نگوید.
miniContext: The babysitter had been **explicitly** told not to let the children watch television after dinner. When the kids asked, she repeated the rule clearly so there would be no confusion. Later, the parents thanked her for following their instructions so exactly. They said many previous sitters had ignored rules that weren't explicitly repeated in person.

examples: A good moderator can facilitate discussion without dominating it.
یک مجری خوب می‌تواند بحث را تسهیل کند بدون آن‌که بر آن مسلط شود.
The new bridge will facilitate trade between the two regions.
پل جدید تجارت بین دو منطقه را تسهیل خواهد کرد.
The app facilitates communication between remote team members.
این اپلیکیشن ارتباط بین اعضای تیم دوردست را تسهیل می‌کند.
miniContext: A skilled interpreter can **facilitate** communication between two groups that don't share a common language. During the negotiation, the interpreter didn't take sides but simply made sure both parties understood each other correctly. Without someone to facilitate the conversation, small misunderstandings could easily have turned into serious disagreements. By the end of the meeting, both sides thanked the interpreter for making the discussion possible at all.

examples: Gas prices tend to fluctuate throughout the year.
قیمت بنزین معمولاً در طول سال نوسان دارد.
Her mood can fluctuate quickly depending on how tired she is.
خلق‌وخوی او می‌تواند به سرعت و بسته به میزان خستگی‌اش نوسان داشته باشد.
The temperature in the desert fluctuates dramatically between day and night.
دما در بیابان بین روز و شب به شدت نوسان دارد.
miniContext: Farmers in the valley know that vegetable prices **fluctuate** depending on the weather each season. A dry summer can cause prices to rise sharply, while a good harvest brings them back down just as quickly. Because the market fluctuates so much, many farmers sign fixed contracts with local restaurants instead of relying on daily prices. This gives them a more predictable income despite the unpredictable weather.

examples: The committee will formulate a new policy on remote work.
کمیته یک سیاست جدید درباره‌ی کار از راه دور تدوین خواهد کرد.
Scientists formulated a theory to explain the strange results.
دانشمندان یک نظریه برای توضیح نتایج عجیب تدوین کردند.
She carefully formulated her answer before speaking.
او پاسخش را با دقت صورت‌بندی کرد پیش از آن‌که صحبت کند.
miniContext: Before presenting to investors, the founders spent two weeks trying to **formulate** a clear explanation of how their app made money. Early drafts were too technical, and later ones sounded too vague. Eventually, they formulated a simple one-sentence summary that anyone could understand. Investors later said that clear sentence was the reason they remembered the pitch at all.

examples: The company wants to incentivize employees to use public transportation.
شرکت می‌خواهد کارمندان را برای استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی تشویق کند.
Offering discounts can incentivize customers to buy in bulk.
ارائه‌ی تخفیف می‌تواند مشتریان را برای خرید عمده تشویق کند.
The school incentivized reading by giving prizes for finished books.
مدرسه با دادن جایزه برای کتاب‌های خوانده‌شده، مطالعه را تشویق کرد.
miniContext: The gym wanted to **incentivize** members who exercised regularly, so it introduced a point system with small rewards. Members who motivated themselves with personal goals, like a new pair of running shoes, often stuck with the program longer. After six months, attendance had noticeably increased across all age groups. The owner credited the simple rewards for helping incentivize people during the slower winter months.

examples: The city needs to invest more in public transport infrastructure.
شهر باید سرمایه‌گذاری بیشتری در زیرساخت حمل‌ونقل عمومی انجام دهد.
After the earthquake, much of the region's infrastructure was damaged.
پس از زلزله، بخش زیادی از زیرساخت منطقه آسیب دید.
Reliable internet infrastructure is essential for remote schools.
زیرساخت اینترنت قابل‌اعتماد برای مدارس دورکار ضروری است.
miniContext: After years of heavy traffic complaints, the city finally invested in upgrading its road **infrastructure**. New bridges, wider lanes, and better drainage systems were built over two years. Residents noticed fewer traffic jams almost immediately after the infrastructure improvements were finished. Local officials said the project would also reduce flooding during the rainy season.

examples: Employees are expected to act with honesty and integrity.
از کارمندان انتظار می‌رود با صداقت و درستی عمل کنند.
The engineer checked the structural integrity of the old bridge.
مهندس یکپارچگی ساختاری پل قدیمی را بررسی کرد.
A backup copy protects the integrity of your data.
یک نسخه‌ی پشتیبان از صحت داده‌های شما محافظت می‌کند.
miniContext: The journalist was known throughout her career for refusing to publish a story unless she had verified its **integrity**. Editors sometimes pressured her to rush articles, but she insisted on checking every fact first. Readers trusted her work because they knew her integrity mattered more to her than speed. That reputation eventually earned her a position at one of the country's most respected newspapers.

examples: It can be hard to interpret his jokes if you don't know him well.
اگر او را خوب نشناسی، تفسیر کردن شوخی‌هایش سخت است.
The judge had to interpret the law in an unusual case.
قاضی مجبور شد قانون را در یک پرونده‌ی غیرمعمول تفسیر کند.
She interpreted his silence as a sign of disagreement.
او سکوت او را نشانه‌ای از مخالفت تفسیر کرد.
miniContext: Art teachers often remind students that two people can **interpret** the same painting in completely different ways. One student might see sadness in the dark colors, while another finds calmness in the same shades. There is rarely a single correct way to interpret a piece of art. Teachers encourage students to explain their reasoning rather than guess what the right answer might be.

examples: You don't need to justify your decision to everyone.
لازم نیست تصمیمت را برای همه توجیه کنی.
The manager tried to justify the sudden price increase.
مدیر تلاش کرد افزایش ناگهانی قیمت را توجیه کند.
Her excellent results justified the extra hours of practice.
نتایج عالی او ساعت‌های اضافی تمرین را توجیه کرد.
miniContext: The city council had to **justify** its decision to close the old library before building a new one. Residents demanded clear reasons, since the old building held decades of memories. Officials explained that repair costs alone would justify the move, pointing to a damaged roof and outdated wiring. After a public meeting, most residents accepted the explanation, even if they still felt nostalgic.

examples: The new update brought only a marginal improvement in speed.
به‌روزرسانی جدید تنها بهبود جزئی در سرعت ایجاد کرد.
There was a marginal difference between the two test scores.
تفاوت جزئی بین دو نمره‌ی آزمون وجود داشت.
His role in the project was marginal compared to the others.
نقش او در پروژه در مقایسه با دیگران حاشیه‌ای بود.
miniContext: After months of training, the runner noticed only a **marginal** improvement in her race time. Her coach reminded her that marginal gains eventually add up over a full season. Instead of chasing one big breakthrough, she focused on small, marginal changes to her diet, sleep, and stretching routine. By the end of the year, those tiny improvements combined into a personal best.

examples: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the match continued as planned.
علی‌رغم باران شدید، مسابقه طبق برنامه ادامه یافت.
The risks notwithstanding, she decided to take the job abroad.
با وجود خطرات، او تصمیم گرفت آن شغل را در خارج از کشور قبول کند.
His objections notwithstanding, the board approved the new budget.
با وجود مخالفت‌های او، هیئت‌مدیره بودجه‌ی جدید را تصویب کرد.
miniContext: The festival organizers decided to proceed with the outdoor concert, heavy rain **notwithstanding**. Ticket refunds notwithstanding, almost nobody asked for their money back once the music started. The mud and the cold notwithstanding, fans stayed until the very last song. Organizers later said that, all the difficulties notwithstanding, it became one of the festival's most memorable nights.

examples: You can change the parameter to control how fast the animation plays.
می‌توانی پارامتر را تغییر دهی تا سرعت پخش انیمیشن را کنترل کنی.
The experiment had one key parameter: the amount of sunlight.
آزمایش یک پارامتر کلیدی داشت: مقدار نور خورشید.
Budget and deadline are the two main parameters of this project.
بودجه و مهلت زمانی دو پارامتر اصلی این پروژه هستند.
miniContext: In the cooking class, the instructor explained that temperature was the most important **parameter** when baking bread. Changing just this one parameter could turn a loaf from perfectly golden to badly burnt. Students experimented by holding every other variable constant and adjusting only the oven's temperature. By testing one parameter at a time, they finally understood why their first loaves kept failing.

examples: The preliminary results of the study look promising.
نتایج مقدماتی این مطالعه امیدوارکننده به نظر می‌رسند.
Before the main interview, candidates must pass a preliminary test.
قبل از مصاحبه‌ی اصلی، داوطلبان باید در یک آزمون مقدماتی قبول شوند.
A preliminary sketch helped the architect plan the final design.
یک طرح مقدماتی به معمار کمک کرد تا طراحی نهایی را برنامه‌ریزی کند.
miniContext: Before the official competition began, judges reviewed each contestant's **preliminary** application to check basic eligibility. A few applicants were eliminated at this early preliminary stage for missing required documents. Those who passed moved on to interviews and live auditions. Organizers said the preliminary review saved time by filtering out incomplete entries before the busier rounds started.

examples: The rules prohibit smoking inside the building.
قوانین سیگار کشیدن در داخل ساختمان را ممنوع می‌کنند.
Local law prohibits parking on this street after 6 p.m.
قانون محلی پارک کردن در این خیابان بعد از ساعت شش عصر را ممنوع می‌کند.
Doctors prohibited her from lifting heavy objects after the surgery.
پزشکان او را از بلند کردن اجسام سنگین پس از عمل جراحی منع کردند.
miniContext: The new building rules **prohibit** residents from keeping large pets in apartments without a balcony. Several tenants complained that the rule felt unfair to families with gentle, well-behaved dogs. Management explained that the rule was meant to prevent noise complaints, not to prohibit pets entirely. After negotiations, the building agreed to allow smaller pets under a certain weight.

examples: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
تنبیه باید متناسب با جرم باشد.
Her salary increase was proportionate to her years of experience.
افزایش حقوق او متناسب با سال‌های تجربه‌اش بود.
The company's response was proportionate to the size of the complaint.
واکنش شرکت متناسب با اندازه‌ی شکایت بود.
miniContext: The teacher believed that homework should be **proportionate** to how much material was covered in class that week. During exam weeks, she assigned a proportionate amount of extra review instead of piling on new topics. Students appreciated that the workload matched the difficulty of each unit. Parents also noticed that a proportionate approach reduced stress compared to previous years.

examples: Can you retrieve the file I deleted yesterday?
می‌توانی فایلی که دیروز حذف کردم را بازیابی کنی؟
The dog ran into the lake to retrieve the ball.
سگ برای بازیابی توپ به داخل دریاچه دوید.
She retrieved her passport from the hotel safe before checkout.
او گذرنامه‌اش را قبل از تخلیه از گاوصندوق هتل بازیابی کرد.
miniContext: After the flood, volunteers worked for days to **retrieve** important documents from the damaged basement. Some papers were too wet to save, but many were carefully dried and retrieved in time. Families were relieved to get back photographs and certificates they thought were lost forever. The experience convinced several residents to store copies of important documents somewhere safer in the future.

examples: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
می‌توانی در این دستور پخت عسل را جایگزین شکر کنی.
The coach decided to substitute the injured player in the second half.
مربی تصمیم گرفت بازیکن مصدوم را در نیمه‌ی دوم جایگزین کند.
No app can fully substitute for a face-to-face conversation.
هیچ اپلیکیشنی نمی‌تواند به طور کامل جایگزین یک گفتگوی رودررو شود.
miniContext: When the lead singer lost her voice right before the concert, the band had to find a **substitute** within hours. A backup singer who already knew most of the songs agreed to substitute for the night. Fans noticed the change but stayed supportive once they heard how well she performed. The band later said that having a reliable substitute ready had saved the entire show.

examples: We don't have sufficient evidence to reach a conclusion yet.
ما هنوز شواهد کافی برای رسیدن به یک نتیجه نداریم.
A few hours of sleep were not sufficient for her to feel rested.
چند ساعت خواب برای احساس استراحت او کافی نبود.
Is one bottle of water sufficient for the whole hike?
آیا یک بطری آب برای تمام مسیر پیاده‌روی کافی است؟
miniContext: The hikers debated whether they had packed **sufficient** water for the long desert trail. Their guide insisted that two liters per person would not be sufficient in such heat. After refilling their bottles at the last station, they finally felt confident they had enough. The decision to double-check turned out to be more than sufficient to get everyone through safely.

examples: The first meeting went well, and subsequent meetings were even better.
جلسه‌ی اول خوب پیش رفت و جلسات بعدی حتی بهتر بودند.
Subsequent research confirmed the results of the original study.
تحقیقات بعدی نتایج مطالعه‌ی اصلی را تأیید کرد.
He apologized, and his subsequent behavior showed real change.
